pairs.expectations: A DELE B2 listening set for a Brazilian Portuguese reader: script and questions in Spanish, every reason and misconception in Brazilian Portuguese.
pairs.defect: Every reason and misconception of the second question is written in Spanish instead of Brazilian Portuguese, so the learner gets the explanation of that answer in the language they are being tested on.
pairs.falseAllegation: The questions and options are written in Brazilian Portuguese instead of Spanish.
pairs.provenance: Eval case pt-dele-b2-tarea-5-monologue output from GPT-6.1 Terra (synthetic, no learner data); the flawed side translates question two reasons to Spanish by hand.
